items.label: Latest Android 16 Tablet
items.value: This 10-inch tablet runs on Android 16 and features built-in Gemini AI for smooth multitasking, reduced power consumption, and enhanced data security. It includes a built-in ad-blocking function to effectively block annoying ads. Significant improvements and enhancements have been made to the user interface, multitasking, and other aspects.

items.label: Octa-core Processor
items.value: This Android 16 tablet features an octa-core processor, 24 GB (4+20) of RAM, and 64 GB of ROM storage (expandable to 2 TB TF card). A built-in blue light filter protects your eyes even during extended reading or video watching. You can enjoy smooth video playback, work, and study.

items: Stability Upgrade - This tablet boasts a stunning 10.1-inch Ultra HD display. With a 1280 x 800 pixel resolution, it delivers vibrant, lifelike colors and sharp, crisp details. Enjoy an immersive visual experience whether watching movies, surfing the web, or working efficiently. A high-performance 6000 mAh battery provides long-lasting battery life, allowing you to enjoy your tablet all day long.

Ultimate performance - It features a dual-camera setup with a 5MP main sensor and an 8MP secondary sensor. As a GMS-certified Android tablet, you have full access to the Google Play Store and all your favorite apps. It also features 2.4G/5G Wi-Fi and Bluetooth 5.0. Precise GPS navigation makes it a practical navigation device for cars or travel.

items.label: The package includes
items.value: 1 x 10.1-inch tablet, 1 x keyboard, 1 x mouse, 1 x pen, 1 x protective case, 1 x tempered glass, and a charger. It's an ideal gift for students, professionals, or children.
